scope: Frozen High DAY quarter only, twelve destinations, four views, clear/rain. No catalogue rescoring or whole criterion closure.

inspection.coverage_note: All twelve destinations inspected on contact pages, with current full originals across all twelve in clear and rain. Fine defects are supported only by opened originals; contact-only entries do not claim full-resolution inspection.

owning_requirements: Coherent reference-backed terrain, architecture and material families; integrated ground/structural contact and readable routes.
Cloudreach layered upland/cliff/cloud identity and legible landmark materials.
World and UI readability without heavy billboard clutter. Static views cannot prove motion, combat, device or earned travel requirements.

largest_three_supported_failures.subject: Realm Gate structural contact
largest_three_supported_failures.requirement: Grounded coherent architecture and route integration
largest_three_supported_failures.reason: Gate tower bases/threshold plank are visibly suspended above the grass approach in both inspected headings. The gate identity is readable but the physical visual union is not.

largest_three_supported_failures.subject: Paving and ground integration
largest_three_supported_failures.requirement: Coherent material transitions without unfinished cuts/intersections
largest_three_supported_failures.reason: Large green wedges interrupt Perches paving; Stormward has notched path cuts/thin brown slivers; an Observatory tree emerges through solid paving without a legible planting edge; the pictured Cliffhold interior retains grass/dirt floor.

largest_three_supported_failures.subject: Scenery/UI readability and presentation
largest_three_supported_failures.requirement: Legible world presentation without heavy billboard clutter
largest_three_supported_failures.reason: The large story objective panel/minimap cover a substantial portion of bridge/architecture/right-side vistas. Near trainer and route usually remain readable, so this is distinct from landmark identity failure. Broad repeated turf/coarse grass and cliff planes also limit the reference finish.

full_day_appearance.reason: Supported structural contact, court integration and presentation defects remain.

landmark_material_separation.scope: Bounded pictured pale masonry versus gold/sky/green at Arch, Shrine, Aviary and Bridge; not full landmark criterion closure.

static_depth_and_weather_readability.scope: Pictured cliff layers/cloud deck and near route/trainer read in clear and rain. Full atmosphere/time/motion bar is not proved.

ground_and_structure_contact.scope: Gate and specifically evidenced paving/interior junctions.

near_trainer_and_route.scope: Selected opened originals generally show readable trainer and near route without gross body burial. No collision/unsupported-stand physics proof, traversal or all-pose clearance certification.

ui_world_presentation.scope: Heavy pictured HUD coverage of scenery. No menu/device usability claim.

perch_arrival_departure_landing_camera.scope: Pictured court views do not establish all required arrival/departure or landing transition contexts.

literal_all_contexts_no_floating_clippin.scope: Gate/paving failures are visible; no fight or whole-matrix absence proof. No flat magenta combat effect is seen in these scenery stills, which cannot certify its absence in fights.
